channel.title: Wire — Ruby
channel.description: Ruby from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Ruby 2D 1.0: SDL3, WebAssembly, and a Comeback Story
item.description: Make 2D applications with Ruby. Ruby 2D is a library for creating 2D applications, games, graphics, and interactive art in a way that's simple, natural, and joyful, in the spirit of Ruby itself. (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: Learn how to use its DSL here
item.description: Write Ruby 2D code and run it right in your browser. No install required. (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: Tom's story of resurrecting the project
item.description: A ground-up rewrite more than a decade in the making, and the story of how it very nearly didn't happen at all. (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: 🚨 We Audited 137 Rails Apps. 98% Had a Critical KEV
item.description: A read-only assessment of your images, clusters, runtimes, databases, and pipelines. Prioritized findings and a 30-60-90 day plan in four to six weeks. (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: Rails is done
item.description: The core of Rails has stood the tests of time. To this day, it is a great way to build web applications. But DHH’s view of the world is fundamentally incompatible with mine, and I’m not the only one who feels that way. (2 sources: lobsters, rubyweekly)

item.title: Speeding Up (small) Ruby Hashes
item.description: Something I must confess is that I absolutely hate writing these blog posts. It’s not quite as bad as having to give a conference talk, but it’s up there on the list of activities that feel like pulling teeth to me. (2 sources: lobsters, rubyweekly)

item.title: json 3.0.0 RC1 Released for Testing
item.description: JSON implementation for Ruby. Contribute to ruby/json development by creating an account on GitHub. (1 source: rubyweekly)
